user_instruction: 继续此前建议：先用已有数据检查跨步幅度漂移和固定/廉价前置信号，不重新生成视频。
primary_focus: block39, chosen from already exposed observations; all five blocks reported
hypotheses: A step/expert-specific scalar or fixed affine correction transfers across the six discovery sources.
Pre-FFN input magnitude or projection adds useful information beyond a strong matched fixed correction.
High raw similarity is mainly a spatial common component; centered motion remains poorly reusable.
evaluation: Leave one entire source out; fit only the other five at the same block and target step. All six sources were already discovery-exposed, so this is descriptive cross-source transfer, not fresh holdout quality validation.
calibration_objective: Mean of per-source gate-weighted SSE / current gated-output energy. Closed-form least squares only; no optimizer, neural fitting, checkpoint change or model execution.
available_current_predictor_field: modulated_input, before Smooth1/Q1/W1; current gate and same-expert original b2 are available independently of current FFN output
cache_semantics: Previous un-gated FFN output; apply current gate. Same latent coordinates, not object tracking. Same-expert b2 must be identical before using bias-preserving controls.
scope_limits: 32 sampled rows per source, no native reuse or independent videos, no speed/quality acceptance, no automatic followup or operator promotion
